Plant opened

Ama Fixture Mensah, the Member of Parliament for Fixture East, opened a new water treatment plant on Friday. The plant is expected to serve two hundred thousand residents of the district and was financed from the common fund. Officials said construction took fourteen months and was completed within budget. The regional minister attended the ceremony together with chiefs and assembly members from the area.

Ama Fixture Mensah was born in 1961. Ama Fixture Mensah was born in 1979. She is the Member of Parliament for Fixture East. She has never held public office. The plant opened in 2019. The plant has not been built.
